messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - high tail latency on embedder queue (region: us-west). Auto-acknowledged, routing to oncall.
mason: saw it. spike started ~02:17 UTC. Affected ~3% of requests, error rate ~0.8% for embeddings path.
anya: I'm on the page. digging into queue depth and recent deploys.
raj: tagging @tess for downstream router visibility / customer-facing comms.
incident-bot: Live metrics: embed-queue-length=78 -> 12 after backpressure; p50/p95/p99 latencies: 12/140/410ms.
leo: recent deploy at 01:56 had a quantization tweak. rolling it back now on canary.
mason: rollback started. canary rolled back at 02:22, backpressure easing.
anya: confirming KV cache hit rate dropped around spike, maybe eviction thrash from new config.
tess: noting customer impact: two paying customers (acct-227, acct-902) saw elevated latency for 8-12 minutes. ops will flag for credits if confirmed.
mason: mitigation complete, traffic normalized by 02:30.
raj: nice. recommend we schedule a 30m post-incident review tomorrow to capture root cause and action items.
product-ops: can do. prefer 10:00 UTC tomorrow — gives eng time to gather logs.
anya: will attach timeline and correlation graphs to the postmortem doc before the meeting.
leo: proposed action items: 1) revert risky quant flags from auto-deploy (owner: leo, size: small, due: next sprint), 2) add KV eviction telemetry (owner: anya, size: medium, due: next sprint), 3) add runbook step to pause batch config rollouts on high tail latency (owner: mason, size: small, due: this week), 4) customer credit ops workflow (owner: tess, size: small, product-ops to approve).
tess: agree. add a Q2 tie: evaluate safer quant rollout gating in Optimize (owner: product-ops + eng-research, size: large, quarter: Q2).
raj: labeling severities for backlog: small = <2d effort, medium = 1 sprint, large = multi-sprint. I'll create tickets and link them to the postmortem and the quarterly planning board.
product-ops: scheduling postmortem meeting 10:00 UTC tomorrow — invite sent to participants above + infra-qa.
mason: posting follow-up here once tickets are created.
incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem doc and include a customer-impact section and remediation ticket links."
